scientific.integrity: The finite census is exact because the proof reduces all degree-two targets to all \(3^{15}\) ternary vectors and all possible summands to all \(2^{15}\) sign vectors.  The packaged verifier exhausts both domains and independently checks the orbit partition; no randomized sampling or extrapolation is used. The verified final census is \(|H_2|=135240\), with natural \(\operatorname{AGL}(4,2)\) orbit sizes \(840,13440,26880,40320,53760\).
scientific.limitations: The claim classifies only degree-two holes of the order-16 Sylvester truncation \(P_{5,1}\).  It does not classify higher-degree holes, compute the full Hilbert basis, settle other parameter pairs, or identify the full automorphism group beyond the displayed natural \(\operatorname{AGL}(4,2)\) action.

title: Degree-two hole census for the integral nonnormal Sylvester truncation \(P_{5,1}\)
